name: True Love Story: Fan Disk
original_name: トゥルー・ラブストーリー・ファンディスク
source: In this fandisc, the protagonist has two little sisters who are twins. The player must choose the correct topics of conversation so he can win the heart of one (or even both!) of the twins.
translation: In this fandisc, the protagonist has two little sisters who are twins. The player must choose the correct topics of conversation so he can win the heart of one (or even both!) of the twins.
